title: Dromana Community Market
summary: Community market at Dromana Park on the last Saturday of every month. Mix of produce, craft, plants and local makers.
recurrenceNote: Monthly – Last Saturday of every month
nearbyAttractions: Dromana Beach; Dromana Indoor Market; Peninsula Hot Springs
editorVerdict: Dromana's last-Saturday market is a community Saturday, not a destination. Useful if you're already heading to the beach.
editorNote:
The Dromana Community Market runs the last Saturday of the month at Dromana Park. Expect produce, craft, plants and local makers, the standard Peninsula community-market mix. No website of its own, so dates are best confirmed via the Shire's events feed before you drive.

Go if you're combining it with a Dromana foreshore morning or a trip up Arthurs Seat. Skip if you're chasing the bigger Red Hill or Mornington Racecourse experience the same weekend.
